8230.title: Unchanged browser tasks bypass Turbo caching
8230.rootCauseOneLine: Package-level cache:false overrides force browser-automation build and test to execute despite unchanged task hashes.

prReviews.topFinding: Removes both cache overrides and adds a direct topo edge; restoration and invalidation checks not executed against the PR.

8230.proposedFix: Restore caching for build/test, preserve smoke exclusions, and verify direct dependency hashing and output restoration; existing PR #8231 covers this work.
8230.caveats: SDK runtime must be built explicitly before a cold plugin-only build. Windows, output-restoration equivalence, and full hermeticity on other systems were not verified.
